question:
Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:

My Lute Awake is a lyric poem with eight five-line stanzas and a refrain. The poem opens with the use of a literary device known as Apostrophe, in which the poet personifies the only living lute, calling it to get awake, for one last time, so that both he and the poet can complete the last task before they die. The poet feels repulsive to his lady. So the poem is bitter in tone. The bitterness became more intense, and the speaker of the poem becomes violent as he proclaims, Vengeance shall fall on thy disdain. The lady is not innocent, though as she 'makest but a game on earnest pain'. Therefore, cruelty demands punishment. The poet predicts the future of the lady, saying that she may end her days in loneliness, Perchance thee lie wethered and old/The winter nights that are so cold. The reason is that she has been extraordinarily heartless; therefore, there is no possibility that anyone can love her for long. The poem is embittered and follows the philosophy of Carpe Diem, as do the previous poems. The poet warns the lady to respond soon or face the consequences.

 

What is the literary device that gives a shape to the dramatic opening of 'My Lute Awake'?
option_1: Hyperbole to highlight the poet's emotional chaos by means of exaggeration
option_2: Apostrophe because the poet speaks directly to his lute, which is a personification
option_3: Alliteration that throws light on the musicality of the poem through consonant repetition
option_4: Paradox the contradictory character of love and hate is revealed
solution_text:
The correct answer is 'Apostrophe because the poet speaks directly to his lute, which is a personification'.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The passage states: “The poem opens with the use of a literary device known as Apostrophe, in which the poet personifies the only living lute, calling it to get awake, for one last time, so that both he and the poet can complete the last task before they die.”

• This is reinforced elsewhere: “My Lute Awake is a lyric poem with eight five-line stanzas and a refrain.”

• This directly supports ‘Apostrophe because the poet speaks directly to his lute, which is a personification’ as the answer.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

question:
Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:

Antonin Artaud was associated with Surrealism and avant-garde theatre. His eventual departure from Surrealism made him develop the Theatre of Cruelty and publish its theories in the work called Theatre and Its Double. He removed the barrier between the performers and the audience. He made use of oversized props, lightning effects, groans, screams and verbal incantations to strike the audience's emotions and senses with an array of technical effects in order to make them face the unreal, ugly and grotesque pain. The whole idea of the theatre of cruelty was to leave a lasting impact on the psychology of the audience.

 

What led Antonin Artaud to develop the Theatre of Cruelty?
option_1: His rejection of traditional realism and his desire to create a theatre based on calm, reflective storytelling
option_2: His interest in psychological naturalism inspired by Stanislavsky’s methods of acting
option_3: His attempt to revive classical Greek theatre and restore its poetic structure
option_4: His departure from Surrealism, which pushed him toward formulating a radical, sensory-driven performance style
solution_text:
The correct answer is 'His departure from Surrealism, which pushed him toward formulating a radical, sensory-driven performance style'.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The passage states: “His eventual departure from Surrealism made him develop the Theatre of Cruelty and publish its theories in the work called Theatre and Its Double.”

• This is reinforced elsewhere: “Antonin Artaud was associated with Surrealism and avant-garde theatre.”

• This directly supports ‘His departure from Surrealism, which pushed him toward formulating a radical, sensory-driven performance style’ as the answer.
